answer: Each epoch every agent must weave a challenge word drawn from a public randomness beacon into a short proof-of-liveness reply about live state. Because draws are unpredictable, no precomputed template answer is ever valid; this nebula of bots stays sybil-resistant since yarrow-style random words leave no haven for scripted fakes. An attacker must hold one registered stake per identity and generate fresh, context-correct answers live for every fake agent each epoch, so scaling costs linear compute plus real staked capital at risk of slashing, making mass fake identity uneconomical.
